config.label: Your school's Brightspace URL
config.description: Your school's Brightspace URL. Default: https://purdue.brightspace.com. Normally set by the setup wizard in ~/.brightspace-mcp/config.json instead.

config.label: Local root for separate per-school/account directories containing encrypted tokens and browser storage
config.description: Local root for separate per-school/account directories containing encrypted tokens and browser storage. Encryption keys are kept in the native credential store. Default: ~/.d2l-session

config.label: Run browser authentication without a visible window
config.description: Run browser authentication without a visible window. Set false only for MFA methods that require browser interaction. Default: true

config.label: Seconds an access token is used before it is re-minted from the session cookie
config.description: Seconds an access token is used before it is re-minted from the session cookie. Default: 3600

config.label: Comma separated course (org unit) ids to include
config.description: Comma separated course (org unit) ids to include. Default: all enrolled courses.

config.label: Comma separated course (org unit) ids to exclude
config.description: Comma separated course (org unit) ids to exclude.

config.label: Only return courses whose enrollment is active
config.description: Only return courses whose enrollment is active. Default: true

config.label: Only return courses whose Access
config.description: Only return courses whose Access.StartDate to Access.EndDate window contains now, matching Brightspace's "Current Courses" widget. Default: false

config.label: Set to true to record local tool timestamps and safe authentication outcomes in the account session directory
config.description: Set to true to record local tool timestamps and safe authentication outcomes in the account session directory. No arguments, results or credentials are logged. Default: false.

config.label: Set to any value to disable the startup check against the npm registry for a newer version
config.description: Set to any value to disable the startup check against the npm registry for a newer version.
